synoptic_overview: Final cold-core low exits with wraparound showers.

storm.notes: Isolated thunder with small hail possible.

flood.notes: Urban ponding where drains remain clogged.

wildfire.notes: Gusty backside winds dry fuels briefly.

alerts: Clear lingering flood advisories as rivers fall below action stage.
Message transportation crews about slick passes during night transition.
preparedness_actions: Cycle crews to debris removal on urban drains.
Rotate IMT duty officers for rest ahead of next system.

synoptic_overview: Shortwave trough sparks afternoon convection statewide.

flood.notes: Brief downpours may overwhelm urban drainage.

wildfire.notes: Dry lightning risk east of Cascades.

alerts: Issue lightning watch east of Cascades.
Coordinate with aviation partners on convective routing options.
preparedness_actions: Prepare rapid-response fire crews for potential holdover strikes.
Brief public on safe sheltering during lightning.

synoptic_overview: High pressure rebuilds; offshore gradients spark downslope winds east of Cascades.

storm.notes: Stable skies with diminishing cloud cover.

heat.notes: Daytime highs nudge above average where downslope warming occurs.

wildfire.notes: Dry windy corridor elevates ignition risk east of Cascades.

alerts: Post red flag watch for eastern basins if humidity dips below 20%.
Notify utility partners about potential wind-driven line fatigue.
preparedness_actions: Pre-position wildfire strike teams in lee of Cascades.
Stage community cooling and clean-air shelters in high-wind corridors.
